from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDetail(BaseModel):
    """Extracted facts from a single judgment document relevant to matching outcomes."""
    procedure_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of legal proceeding (e.g., '二审民事判决书', '执行复议审查裁定')")
    appealing_parties: list[str] = Field(description="Names of appellants or review applicants initiating the action")
    ruling_conclusion: str | None = Field(description="Core verdict text (e.g., '驳回上诉，维持原判', '驳回复议申请')")
    cost_responsibility: list[str] = Field(description="Names of parties responsible for bearing court fees, if stated")
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="Court or jurisdiction name")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDetail]
